stemMd: During aerobic respiration in a human cell, molecular oxygen is used directly in which role?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Final electron acceptor in the respiratory electron-transport chain

options.label: B
options.textMd: Substrate split into glucose by glycolysis

options.label: D
options.textMd: Carrier of amino acids to ribosomes

options.label: E
options.textMd: Source of all carbon atoms in carbon dioxide

explanationMd: Oxygen accepts electrons at the end of the respiratory chain and participates in water formation. It does not provide the carbon released as carbon dioxide, which originates in the oxidised fuel.

distractorRationale.e: Carbon dioxide carbon comes from organic fuels.
distractorRationale.b: Glycolysis breaks down glucose and does not make it from oxygen.
distractorRationale.d: That is a role of transfer RNA.
distractorRationale.c: Oxygen is not a protein enzyme.
